title: Guard claim reaping with device-in-use check
description:
collect_stale_session_ids() reaps a claim purely on is_pid_alive(claimant_pid). claimant_pid() binds the claim to os.getppid() — the shell that ran 'simemu claim'. When that shell is short-lived (zsh -c wrapper), the claim reads dead while the DEVICE is still in active use by a different process (xcodebuild -destination id=<udid>). _reap_dead_claims_locked then marks the session expired, freeing the device for a sibling to claim — producing the double-claim incident exclusive.py exists to prevent. Observed live: session s-32cc55 held chard (16D8CDC7) with dead claimant pid 62666 while xcodebuild ran a Vivii test against that same UDID.

See also: T-054 (symptom-level report of the same PID-liveness reaping issue, filed independently) and T-056 (v2 sessions have no on-demand release verb at all -- same claim-lifecycle subsystem).

context.text: codex gate returned FAIL. Guard fails OPEN: ps probe failure returns [] which reads as device-idle and reaps the claim - the exact double-claim the change prevents. Test test_probe_failure_does_not_block_reaping asserts the unsafe behaviour. Also TOCTTOU between snapshot and expiry write, and process table can be scanned twice under the session lock. Proof at proof/T-LU-054/codex-verdict.txt. NOT merged.

acceptanceCriteria: A claim whose claimant PID is dead is NOT reaped while any live process references its device UDID
A claim whose claimant PID is dead AND whose device has no live referencing process IS reaped as before
Device-in-use detection is a pure, injectable function so tests need no real simulator
Existing tests in tests/test_exclusive_claim.py and tests/test_claim_policy.py still pass
proofRequirements: pytest output showing new device-in-use guard tests passing plus the full suite green
proof/T-LU-054/codex-verdict.txt with final line VERDICT: PASS
